Our expert team understands the unique challenges posed by the Southern Louisiana climate, and we design and build awnings and carports that provide reliable protection from the elements. Whether you’re seeking shade from the scorching sun or shelter from sudden rain showers, our custom awnings and carports offer the perfect solution for enjoying outdoor living year-round.

With a keen eye for design and a commitment to quality craftsmanship, we ensure that every awning and carport we create complements your home’s architecture and landscape. From classic designs to modern styles, we offer a wide range of options to suit your aesthetic preferences and practical needs. Whether you’re looking to add curb appeal to your home, protect your vehicles from the elements, or create a comfortable outdoor space for entertaining, Louisiana Patio has the expertise and experience to bring your vision to life.
